chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz who said:

key_terms.التَّمَتُّعُ: Tamattu' (a type of Hajj combining Umrah and Hajj with a break)
key_terms.مَا اسْتَدْبَرْتُ: What I foresaw / anticipated (referring to future events)

ai.seo_question: What is the most superior type of Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz inquires about the superior form of Hajj, to which Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms Tamattu' as the best, citing the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) preference for it had he known his future circumstances. This narration underscores the Shia scholarly view that Tamattu' is not merely permissible but highly recommended, reflecting the Prophet’s own practice and preference in the context of the Farewell Pilgrimage. The reference to the Prophet’s statement highlights the continuity between the Prophet’s actions and the Imams’ teachings, reinforcing the legitimacy of Tamattu' in Shia jurisprudence.
